Veteran mechanic Paul Newkirk, Cedar Rapids, Iowa and Don White, Keokuk, Iowa grease the front axle
of one of the three 196l Fords they are preparing for late model stock car racing for the Zecol-Lubaid Co. of
Milwaukee.
So you want to prepare a late model stock car for the races at state fair park. Think it's a matter of
making just a few changes in the car and then you are ready to run? Such is not the case.

mechanic and former midget auto racer from Cedar Rapids, Ia. are now preparing a trio of 1961 Fords that will
be sponsored by the Zecol-Lubaid Company of Milwaukee. White and Eddie Sachs, Coopersburg, Pa. have been
